scope: Installed TypeScript S02 whole sequence: unchanged paired workload against 0.8.26 and exact post-Slice-132 0.8.27 source; subset of the broader Phase 1 protocol
baseline_noise_observation: Five baseline-only blocks, one fresh-process warm-up plus three measured sequences per block, 15 independently audited measurements, no host warnings, 114.934 ms block-median spread (2.324% of median). The pilot cannot qualify p95/p99 or an equivalence threshold. The refreeze changes only candidate source and npm archive identities, campaign runner binding, and product snapshot; schedule, corpus, call boundary, and sample design are unchanged. The exact-source refreeze changes candidate source and package identities only; the same three-sequence S02 candidate smoke passed before timing.
timing_boundary: One fresh-process installed TypeScript async SDK sequence, Engine.open through reopened Engine.close, including SDK post-state reads and materialized results; fixture construction precedes the timer, and direct SQLite canonical-row verification follows it
interpretation_rule: Keep all valid slow samples and report every paired p50 delta, its median and range, pooled p50/p95, host-warning sensitivity and per-block resource totals. Five pairs are descriptive only; no equivalence, significance or release regression threshold is inferred.
invalid_block_rule: Preserve every attempted block. Require clean exact source checkout, retained npm archive and installed byte agreement, exact runner/helper and protocol hashes, one successful warm-up and 20 valid measured sequences, materialized semantic and reopened-state checks, no interleaved direct SQLite verification, stable host/CPU/storage/governor and Node version, no competing build/profiler, at least 1 GiB disk free and zero measured-child swap. Host-only paging drift is a warning with sensitivity analysis.
resource_rule: Record GNU Time child user/system CPU, peak RSS, filesystem I/O, major faults and swap for every fresh process. Do not attribute whole-worker resources to a single stage.
candidate_verdict_rule: Diagnostic whole-product latency comparison only; contrast with engine E01-E12 and Python S02 at their own boundaries and investigate differences. Do not infer data correctness from version agreement.
phase1_limit: This vector-repaired TypeScript S02 subset does not close Rust S02, contention, S03, C01, Pareto coverage, robustness or logic/exception matrices.
